# mausVoice

> Voice typing for your own machine. Press a hotkey, speak, and mausVoice
> transcribes live, cleans it up with AI, and types it into any app. No
> account, no subscription, built with Rust and TypeScript/React.

## Project

- **Name:** mausVoice
- **Site:** https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/maus-inc/mausVoice
- **License:** AGPLv3
- **Maintainer:** Owie Emmanuel (https://github.com/Owie6789)
- **Package Manager:** pnpm@10.11.0 (Turborepo monorepo)

## Quickstart

```bash
pnpm install
cd apps/desktop
pnpm dev:mac        # macOS
pnpm dev:windows    # Windows
```

Prerequisites: Node 18+, pnpm 10, Rust toolchain (Tauri v2).

## Architecture

mausVoice is a Tauri v2 desktop application (Rust + TypeScript/React). The
"Rust is the API, TypeScript is the Brain" pattern keeps all business logic in
TypeScript (Zustand + Immer) while Rust handles native capabilities (audio
capture, keyboard injection, updater, encryption, GPU enumeration, filesystem).

```
User input / System events
        ↓
React + Zustand state (TypeScript)
        ↓
Repos choose local vs. remote storage
        ↓
Tauri commands (Rust API bridge)
        ↓
SQLite, Whisper models, or external services
```

## Repository Structure

| Path | Description |
|---|---|
| `apps/desktop` | Tauri desktop app (Vite + React + Zustand) |
| `apps/desktop/src-tauri` | Rust API layer (native capabilities, SQLite, Whisper) |
| `apps/docs` | Astro + Starlight documentation site |
| `apps/windows-installer` | Windows installer (Tauri) |
| `docs` | Architecture notes, release guides, reference material |
| `packages/*` | Shared packages: types, voice-ai, desktop-native-apis, functions, pricing, UI, utilities, config, shared-fonts, native pill crates |
| `scripts` | Automation and helper scripts |
| `marketing` | Marketing site assets (fonts, images, vendor scripts) |

## Key Features

- **Live transcription:** Streaming nova-3 via Deepgram, or fully local Whisper
  (CPU/GPU) with zero network calls.
- **AI cleanup:** Filler words removed, punctuation and formatting applied via
  LLM (Groq/OpenRouter), with configurable writing styles.
- **Works everywhere:** One hotkey pastes cleaned text into whatever app has focus.
- **Encrypted keys:** Deepgram & Groq API keys stored encrypted with
  XChaCha20-Poly1305. Rotatable in Settings.
- **Personal dictionary:** Custom names, jargon, and shorthand remembered
  across sessions.
- **Cross-platform:** Native builds for macOS (Apple silicon + Intel), Windows,
  and Linux (APT, RPM, AppImage).

## API Keys & Configuration

Two optional keys entered in-app (Settings):
- **Deepgram** (streaming transcription) — https://console.deepgram.com/
- **Groq** (LLM text cleanup) — https://console.groq.com/keys

Keys are encrypted on disk. For fully offline use, leave both empty and use
local Whisper.

## Quality Commands

```bash
pnpm run build         # Build all workspaces (turborepo)
pnpm run lint          # Lint all workspaces
pnpm run check-types   # TypeScript type checking
pnpm run test          # Run tests
pnpm run format        # Prettier format (ts, tsx, md)
```

## State Management

Single Zustand store with Immer. Actions compose pure utility functions and
call into repos. Repos abstract local (SQLite) vs remote persistence.

## Important Patterns

- Never duplicate business logic in Rust; TypeScript owns all decisions.
- Use `<FormattedMessage defaultMessage="..." />` for i18n (never pass `id` prop).
- Database migrations: `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/db/migrations/NNN_description.sql`
- New Tauri commands: define in `commands.rs`, register in `app.rs` invoke_handler.
- Shared package changes require rebuild before downstream consumers see them.
